message.content:
The illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below the masthead, a tagline reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The scene depicts a brightly lit interior of a laundromat. In the center, a man with a large build and short-cropped hair stands hunched over, wearing a white t-shirt, dark-and-light-striped trousers, and green patterned clogs. He holds a round, glass-and-metal washing machine door open with his right hand while carrying a green plastic basin filled with bundles of grey paper currency in his left arm. To the right, another man in a dark jacket, trousers, and a flat cap sits on an orange bench, looking down at a smaller TEMPO magazine in his hands. This smaller magazine features the word "FINIS" and a track-and-field illustration.

On the left, a row of silver metallic washing machines recedes into the background. A small white cup sits on top of one machine. In the lower-left foreground, the top of a man's head wearing a brown flat cap is visible, looking into a circular window. In the background, another man's face is partially visible behind a machine. Large text at the bottom reads "BOLONG-BOLONG INDOSURYA" above smaller white paragraphs. Various headlines and a barcode are located at the top.
